# Xiangqi explorer

This is the narrow, read-only analogue of Lichess's separately deployed opening
explorer. It exposes game statistics and catalog records generated by
`tools.xiangqi_data`; it is not involved in move legality, game transitions,
Pikafish analysis, AI play, or puzzle activity.

Run from the repository root:

```powershell
python -m external.xiangqi_explorer.server --host 127.0.0.1 --port 9002
```
